svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How contour lines are made
svg.desc: Top: a side view of a surface with two humps, cut by horizontal lines at the levels 20, 40 and 60. Bottom: the same surface seen from above. Each cut becomes a closed contour line, and dotted guides show that the points where the side view crosses a level are the points where the matching contour line crosses the middle of the top view. The higher hump has three rings; the lower hump has two.
svg.text: Where the side view is steep,
